scripts.test:rules: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-greenlight "mocha --timeout 20000 lib/test/rules/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:functions: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-greenlight "mocha --timeout 60000 lib/test/integration/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-greenlight
